ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent student support platform that breaks down complex university syllabi into personalized study paths and collaborative practice tests.
ideas.title: AgenticStudySync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven multi-agent architecture pattern that previously won first place at a student hackathon, showcasing working LangGraph pipelines directly relevant to LLMs and automation.

ideas.pitch: A benchmarking tool that evaluates LLM reasoning capabilities and prompt architectures using chess move generation as a proxy task.
ideas.title: ModelPromptChessEvaluator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs hard engineering and a unique benchmarking proxy task that won grand prize at a recent systematic strategies hackathon, appealing to judges looking for deep technical execution.

ideas.pitch: A solo-built or small-team AI platform for detecting, explaining, and mitigating bias in machine learning datasets and automated pipelines.
ideas.title: FairLens Code Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the growing demand for responsible AI and model transparency, echoing a third-place winning formula focused on automated bias detection.

ideas.pitch: A web platform that ingests local water body sensor feeds to predict algal bloom or contamination risks days in advance using machine learning.
ideas.title: AquaPredict IoT Hyderabad
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on clear, measurable environmental impact with a predictive ML pipeline, mirroring an award-winning IoT and water-safety hackathon project.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first mobile web application that captures plant leaf images via camera to classify diseases instantly using lightweight machine learning models.
ideas.title: AgriVision Local Crop Defect Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features a live, working camera-based computer vision demo that solves a practical agricultural problem, similar to UN hackathon-winning solutions.
